## Description

## Type

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] chore — tooling, deps, config
- [ ] docs — documentation
- [ ] refactor — no behavior change
- [ ] test — tests only

## Checklist

- [ ] TypeScript strict mode passes
- [ ] ESLint clean
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Build succeeds
- [ ] No `any` types
- [ ] New endpoints have Swagger docs
- [ ] DB migrations included if schema changed
- [ ] Nothing hardcoded — config in DB
- [ ] PR title: conventional commits format
